subject: general
question: In which year did the cyclone ‘Tauktae’ hit India?
solution:
The correct answer is "__**2021**__".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On** May 17, 2021**, Tauktae, a tropical cyclone with very high winds, made landfall in Gujarat, India.
 
• The same mechanism resulted in **Cyclone Tauktae** when warm waters from the Arabian Sea (up to a depth of 50 metres) created a low-pressure system that intensified over time to become a cyclone.
 
• Cyclone Tauktae, the **fifth-strongest cyclone** to make landfall in the Arabian Sea since 1998, made four days of landfall on the west coast of India between May 14 and May 17, 2021.
 
• At least **91 people **were killed by the storm, which also destroyed thousands of homes, boats, and public buildings across Kerala, Karnataka, Goa, Maharashtra, and Gujarat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **cyclone** has been given the name "**Tauktae**" (pronounce **Tau'Te**) by **Myanmar**.
 
• It is a local term for the noisy reptile known as a "**gecko**" in **Burmese**.
 
• It had an effect on Kerala's and Karnataka's southern regions as well as Goa, Gujarat, and Lakshadweep's western regions.
 
• Along with Dadar and Die, it also hit Nagar Haveli, Dadar, and Dadar, which was followed by flash floods and heavy rain.
